title: Investigation of the gut microbiome in patients with head and neck cancer (HNSCC) and analysis of the prognostic potential of response and tolerability of PD-1, PDL-1 immune checkpoint inhibitors in head and neck cancer
summary: The purpose of this work is to investigate the gut microbiome of patients with head and neck cancer to uncover possible associations with response to therapy with PD-1/PDL-1 checkpoint inhibitors and with the occurrence of adverse immunotherapy-related side effects.

interventions.name: Oncological patients with tumors in the head and neck region for whom therapy with an immune checkpoint inhibitor (PD-1, PD-L1) is planned

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Histologically confirmed head and neck carcinoma for which immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy (PD-1, PD-L1) is planned as part of treatment
Exclusion criteria:
Age under 18, lack of capacity to consent, and lack of patient consent
